newsitem.title: USA: TransAct sees 1997 revs $4 mln lower.
newsitem.headline: TransAct sees 1997 revs $4 mln lower.

text.p: TransAct Technologies Inc said Friday its 1997 revenues will be $4 million less than expected because a customer has shifted the schedule of printer deliveries.
It said a portion of shipments to the customer, ICL Pathway Ltd, will be shifted from the second half of 1997 to 1998 and the first quarter of 1999.
Bart Shuldman, TransAct's president and chief executive officer, said his company was disappointed with the change.
He said, however, that ICL Pathway had increased the quantity of printers to be delivered under a contract, adding $1.2 million to the original contract worth $17 million.
TransAct makes printers and related products used to provide transaction records such as receipts, tickets, coupons, register journals and other documents.
